changes: original_meaning 改按中世纪拉丁语 tenta 的语义实质「被撑开的东西」（tentus『撑开的』的名词化）：现行字段直接写今义「帐篷」，埋没了构词理据。
semantic_path 第二站 how 写明『撑皮于架』的成词画面与它顶替古英语本地词 teld 的史实。
mechanism_sentence 重写（原句为浅述式）。
evidence: Etymonline: "tent (n.) c. 1300, tente, \"portable shelter of skins or coarse cloth stretched over poles,\" from Old French tente \"tent, hanging, tapestry\" (12c.), from Medieval Latin tenta, etymologically \"something stretched out,\" noun use of fem. singular of Latin tentus \"stretched,\" variant past participle of tendere \"to stretch\""
Etymonline: "The notion is of the \"stretching\" of hides, etc. over a framework."
Wiktionary: "Displaced native tilt 'tent', from Old English teld 'tent'."
tent.mechanism_sentence: tent 出自拉丁语 tendere「拉开、撑开」：把兽皮撑在杆子架上，就是帐篷——这个词的本义，是「被撑开的那一片」。

semantic_path.how: 画面即词义：兽皮、粗布撑在杆架上围成遮蔽，就是 tente；古法语 tente 本兼『悬挂物、挂毯』义，英语约 1300 年收的是『撑起的野外住所』一支，并顶替了古英语本地词 teld——词库今义即此。

changes: original_meaning 以链上第一个实词希腊语 thermē 的 gloss 记录为「热」（现行首站取印欧词根的动词 gloss『加热』作原义，词根冒充，已改）；thermal 本词的造词年份（1756）放在第二站。
semantic_path 按 Etymonline 编年重建（1756 年温泉义 → 1837 年泛指热 → 保暖织物义另站、年代来源未注）。
evidence: Etymonline: "thermal (adj.) 1756, \"having to do with hot springs,\" from French thermal (Buffon), from Greek thermē \"heat, feverish heat\" (from PIE root *gwher- \"to heat, warm\"). The sense of \"having to do with heat\" is recorded by 1837. The noun meaning \"rising current of relatively warm air\" is recorded from 1933."
Oxford: "mid 18th cent. (in the sense 'relating to hot springs'): from French, from Greek thermē 'heat'."
thermal.mechanism_sentence: thermal 是 1756 年布封（Buffon）从希腊语 thermē「热」造的词：一开始专指温泉，1837 年泛指一切与热有关的，后来连「存得住热」的保暖衣物都归了它。

semantic_path.how: 造词先窄后宽：1756 年法语 thermal 诞生时只『与温泉有关』，1837 年扩为泛指『与热有关的』——词库『热的，热量的』即此。
『热』又被穿在身上：thermal 落到织物上指专为存热保暖而制者（保暖内衣等）——存得住热，就是卖点；词库『保暖的』即此。（此分义在三套缓存中未注首见年代。）

changes: original_meaning 与古英语 þing 的 gloss 对齐为「集会；所议之事」。
semantic_path 第二站 how 写明 Etymonline 给出的演变推测（审议的议题→事物）及罗曼语的平行线（causa → chose/cosa），均按来源的 probably 口径表述。
evidence: Etymonline: "thing (n.) Middle English thing, from Old English þing, þingc \"meeting, assembly, council, discussion,\" also \"action, deed to be done.\" In late Old English, \"concrete inanimate object; that which exists by itself; entity, being, creature;\" also \"event.\" The sense evolution probably is from the notion of the \"matter\" or subject of deliberation in an assembly."

Etymonline: "Compare French chose, Spanish cosa \"thing,\" from Latin causa \"judicial process, lawsuit, case\"... The sense of \"meeting, assembly\" disappeared by early Middle English but is preserved... in Icelandic, as in Althing, the nation's general assembly."
Wiktionary: "The word originally meant \"assembly\", then came to mean a specific issue discussed at such an assembly, and ultimately came to mean most broadly \"an object\"."
thing.mechanism_sentence: thing 最初是日耳曼人的议事集会：会上要审议的「那件事」，滑成了泛指的「事情」，再落到具体的「东西」——冰岛的全国议会至今还叫 Althing，老义留在了国名里。

semantic_path.how: 桥是『议题』：集会（þing）先转指会上审议的那件『事』（Etymonline 以 probably 提出此演变路径），古英语晚期再落到具体的物与存在物上——罗曼语有一条平行线：法语 chose、西班牙语 cosa 都源自拉丁语 causa『诉讼案』，同是从案头走到物上。集会义在中古英语消失，词库『东西；事物；事情』三义皆出此链。

changes: original_meaning 与古英语 þūma 的见载义对齐为「拇指」：现行首站取词根 *tūm- 的 gloss『生长』，属词根冒充（且 gloss 本身应为『肿胀』，见 Etymonline 的 *tum- \"swell\"）；『粗壮』的语义底子写入 mechanism_sentence。
semantic_path 第二站 how 记录赘字 -b 的来历（12 世纪末，或受 dumb 影响）与 rule of thumb 的年代，均为有据的词史事实，替换五段套话式分站。
evidence: Etymonline: "thumb (n.)... Middle English thoume, from Old English þuma, from Proto-Germanic *thūman-..., etymologically \"the stout or thick (finger),\" from PIE *tum- \"swell,\" from root *teue- \"to swell\" (source of tumor, tuber)."

Etymonline: "The unetymological spelling with -b (attested from late 12c.) is perhaps by influence of dumb; also compare limb... The phrase rule of thumb \"rough guideline\" is attested by 1680s... To use the thumb as a rough measure of an inch is attested from c. 1500."
Oxford: "from an Indo-European root shared by Latin tumere 'to swell'."
thumb.mechanism_sentence: thumb 的语义老底是「粗壮」：它与 tumor（肿块）同根（*tum-「肿、胀」）——五指里最粗短的那根就是拇指；词尾不发音的 b 是 12 世纪末添上的赘字，大概是蹭了 dumb 的写法。

semantic_path.how: 义守恒而史实不少：12 世纪末拼写添上不发音的 -b（或受 dumb 牵连）；约 1500 年人们真拿拇指当一英寸的粗尺子用，1680 年代 rule of thumb『经验法则』定型——词库今义仍是这根最粗的手指。
